name: Mikawa Amane
source:
Poster girl of anisong bar "Blue Comet".

She is innocent, lively, always smiling, and a hardworking good girl. She is very popular among customers.
She loves anime, but her favorite works are mostly considered minor by the public.

As a result, she feels a little lonely because she can't find anyone who shares her exact taste in anime and can talk about it with her wholeheartedly.
Her hobby is knitting, and she has a bit of a homely side to her.
